implementation: FP32 CUDA associative information-form scan (PyTorch CUDA cumsum + batched Cholesky)
domain: identity transition A=I, zero process noise Q=0
notes: Measurements include forward only and use synchronized CUDA timing.
The scan keeps the full dense covariance semantics; it is not a diagonal-covariance approximation.
General dynamics or nonzero process noise use ReplaySSM's dense replay path.
